raw.description: Raw json object received from AWS for fields not extracted via this type

region.description: Region in which the event occurred. E.g. `us-east-1`

eventTime.description: The time, in ISO-8601 format, for example, 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z, when file system finished processing the request

eventName.description: Event-type causing the trigger. E.g. ObjectCreated:Put

object.description: Aws S3 object that triggered the event

title:
Type to hold the S3 event notification. All the commonly used fields have been extracted in this type and the entire
raw json is available via the field {@link AwsS3Event#raw}
name: AwsS3Event
